notes.title: Devlog 1 is Here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
We're so excited to share with you a few of the things we have been working on over the past year. Finding Ice has been in development for over 2 years now and is nearing its release to Steam this month.
[b]
[h3]A brief introduction to Finding Ice:[/h3][/b]
Finding Ice is a game that aims to inspire the player to make small changes in their lives to help the planet and limit climate change. The player explores several large maps as a third-person Arctic Wolf, interacting with the natural surroundings, uncovering clues and challenges and interacting with in-game animals. [i]If you're a fan of adventure games, walking simulators and story/puzzle games, Finding Ice is for you.[/i]
[i][b]
Before you read any further, hit that 'wishlist' button on the Steam store page to be notified when Finding Ice is released - you won't want to miss it.[/b][/i]

Will you re-connect with nature and help to restore balance to the natural world? Or will you be a bystander to one of the worst catastrophes of all time? The choice is yours in this unique video game.

[h3]A bit about DanstaStudios:[/h3]
DanstaStudios is a small indie game development studio which primarily focuses on developing video games that will make a difference in the world. Our latest video game, Finding Ice (wishlist now) follows the story of an Arctic wolf attempting to unlock the secrets of his past in the face of man-made climate change. 
[h3]
So, what features have been added since previous updates?[/h3]

Well, we've been hard at work creating beautiful awe-inspiring worlds and adding a sprinkle of life into each map through the implementation of animals. We've added lakes, rivers and mountainous waterfalls coupled with outstanding swimming mechanics. So, what are you waiting for? WISHLIST TODAY AND SPREAD THE WORD!

Finding Ice will be released later this month.

Thank you - please stay tuned for updates on progress!
